title: What are you doing this weekend?
content_html:
Continue migration of various bits and bobs from MacOS to NixOS. I installed NixOS on my 2018 MacBook Pro last weekend. I haven’t run Linux on my personal hardware in about 2 decades, since I got my first work MacBook. I’m happy with MacOS in general, but nixpkgs no longer supports running as a package manager for Intel Macs in the next version.

My wife recently set up as a local artist and today is partaking in an “open studio” event, so in between relaxing at a local cafe to finish reading my book I will bring her snacks and hot drinks.

Hoping to see Kung Fu Hustle with the boy (nearly 15) for the first time. I’m sure he’ll love it!

I intend to visit a pub and try to book another gig for my band too.
